test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct and meaningful sentence related to a marriage function:

(1) The wedding invitation cards were sent

(2) Guests arrived in traditional attire

(3) The venue was decorated beautifully prior to guests' arrival

(4) The ceremony began with rituals.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentences describe the chronological progression of a wedding event, from preparation to the commencement of rituals.
 
• **Sentence (1) is the first sentence** as it represents the initial stage of any event—notifying the participants:
 
 
• "The wedding invitation cards were sent."
 
 
 
• **Sentence (3) follows** because it describes the preparation of the setting before the event officially begins:
 
 
• "The venue was decorated beautifully prior to guests' arrival."
 
 
 
• **Sentence (2) is the third sentence** as it marks the physical arrival of the people who were invited in the first step:
 
 
• "Guests arrived in traditional attire."
 
 
 
• **Sentence (4) is the final sentence** as it signifies the actual start of the formal wedding proceedings:
 
 
• "The ceremony began with rituals."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **1-3-2-4**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"The wedding invitation cards were sent. The venue was decorated beautifully prior to guests' arrival. Guests arrived in traditional attire. The ceremony began with rituals."
